purpose: Evaluate downstream 12-label generalizability AUROC for LoRA fine-tuning on the 56 gold cases held out of representation learning and checkpoint selection.
population: the 56 gold studies, parked in split 'excluded' by the holdout cohort so that neither contrastive training nor checkpoint selection could see them; the 2 locked-test gold studies are counted only
estimand: True generalisation readout on completely unseen patients/studies: 56 gold studies were never seen during pretraining or checkpoint selection.

probe.standardize: StandardScaler fitted inside each training fold
probe.fold: StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True), stratification computed inside the per-label fold loop
probe.predictions: exactly one held-out decision_function score per study per label
probe.tuning: none; every hyperparameter is fixed here before the first fit

metrics.primary: pooled out-of-fold AUROC per label, macro-averaged over the 12 labels
metrics.tie_policy: midrank. Every reported point estimate comes from sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score.
metrics.rare_labels: MCL has 8 positives over 56 cases: pooled-OOF only, fold-level AUROC declared uninformative in advance

bootstrap.limitation: resampling studies is not resampling patients; anonymisation is per study, so patient identity is unverifiable

before_cl.name: dinov2-unadapted
before_cl.pooling: uniform mean over the three planes

unexposed_full_ft_4blk.name: 4-block Full FT adaptation trained WITHOUT the 56 gold studies (gold-holdout-v1)

unexposed_lora_6blk_r64.name: LoRA 6-block r=64 adaptation trained WITHOUT the 56 gold studies (both-lora-holdout-v1)

unexposed_lora_6blk_r64_bs64_reg.name: LoRA 6-block r=64 BS=64 Regularized + SoftTarget adaptation trained WITHOUT the 56 gold studies (both-lora-holdout-v1)
